answer: Pay rewards into slow vesting instead of a lump sum: each epoch's earnings unlock over thirty epochs, and if any account is later shown to share an operator with others, every linked account's unvested balance is clawed back at once. An honest agent loses nothing by waiting for that dawn. A farm of N fakes keeps N locked balances exposed, and each extra account is one more chance the link is found, so expected loss grows faster than N. Even a whisper of proven linkage empties the whole stack, leaving no safe haven for split identities.
